plugins.name: kana-spec
plugins.description: Write grounded specifications for anything — projects, features, design systems, APIs — through an agentic pipeline: codebase scouts with cited findings, an adaptive interview, adversarial draft review, and compound-engineering artifacts (SPEC.md, CLAUDE.md, prompt.md).

plugins.name: suno-composer
plugins.description: Compose Suno AI songs (v5/v5.5) with a craft-reviewed workflow - dual-form style prompts (modular + narrative), mora-accurate Japanese prosody, duet voice casting, and a lyric-critic agent enforcing a checkable composition rubric. Vision-first or guided modes, artist and tier reference composition, albums, variations, continuations, adaptive preference learning.

plugins.name: kana-code-rpc
plugins.description: Display Claude Code activity as Discord Rich Presence. Shows project name, current activity (tool use, thinking, compacting, waiting), model, context usage, cost, git branch, lines changed, agent name, and a repository link button — with PID-based multi-session daemon support.

plugins.name: anipy-cli
plugins.description: Use Claude Code as a natural language interface for anipy-cli — search, play, download, and manage anime from the terminal on Windows. Self-healing dependency repair (uv, scoop, mpv/vlc) with user confirmation, non-interactive execution via Git Bash, and Windows-specific troubleshooting.
